name: CAC Nantong Chemical Co., Ltd.
summary: CAC Nantong Chemical Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pesticide products and functional chemicals in China, South America, North America, the Southeast Asia, Europe, and internationally. It offers 2,4-D, an herbicide in the phenoxy acetic acid; Chlorothalonil, a protective fungicide; Azoxystrobin, a strobilurin fungicide; and Thiocarbamate herbicides. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Shanghai, China. CAC Nantong Chemical Co., Ltd. operates as a subsidiary of Tahoe Group Co., Ltd.
